subject: general
question: Which of the following types of direct tax collection increased as of 10 February 2023 budget?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Personal income tax**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Personal income tax is a type of direct tax levied by the government on the income of individuals and entities.
 
• The collection of personal income tax saw an increase as per the 10 February 2023 budget.
 
• This increase can be attributed to various economic factors such as higher earnings, improved compliance, and broader tax base.
 
• Personal income tax forms a significant portion of the revenue collected by the government, which is used for public welfare and development projects.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Personal Income Tax**

 
 
• It is a direct tax that individuals or entities pay on their income to the government.
 
• Income tax rates and slabs are determined by the government and can vary based on the amount of income earned.
 
• In most countries, including India, individuals are required to file an annual income tax return detailing their earnings and taxes due.
 
• Personal income tax is used by the government to fund various public services and infrastructure projects.
 
 
 
• **Octroi Duties**
 
 
• Octroi is a local tax collected on various goods entering a municipality or any specific area.
 
• It was a common form of taxation in India but has largely been abolished and replaced by other forms of indirect taxation.
 
 
 
• **Corporate Tax**
 
 
• Corporate tax is a direct tax imposed on the net income or profit of corporations and other business entities.
 
• The tax rate for corporations is usually different from that for individuals.
 
• Corporate tax is a significant source of revenue for the government.
 
 
 
• **Commercial Tax**
 
 
• Commercial tax is a broad term that can include various types of taxes levied on commercial activities.
 
• This can include sales tax, value-added tax (VAT), and goods and services tax (GST).
 
• Commercial taxes are typically indirect taxes collected by the government.
